title: Use secure digit fields

statement.en: Choose or apply secure digit fields in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではsecure digit fieldsを採用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Digit entry views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDigit entry viewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Choose or apply secure digit fields in the documented context.” in the documented Digit entry views context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Choose or apply secure digit fields in the documented context.

apple_native_rule: Choose or apply secure digit fields in the documented context.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.
